pl.tenants.session.signedOut.title: You have signed out
pl.tenants.session.signedOut.description: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue where you left off.
pl.tenants.session.signInFailed.title: We could not sign you in
pl.tenants.session.signInFailed.descript: Try again. If it keeps happening, ask your administrator to check that your account belongs to your organization.
pl.tenants.session.noRole.title: No role assigned yet
pl.tenants.session.noRole.description: You are signed in to {tenant}, but you hold no role there yet. Ask your administrator to give you one.
pl.tenants.session.noRole.descriptionWit: You are signed in, but you hold no role in this organization yet. Ask your administrator to give you one.
pl.tenants.shell.signOutFailed: We could not sign you out. Check your connection and try again.
pl.tenants.role.tenantAdmin.description: Manages members, roles and settings. Grants no business action by itself.
pl.tenants.role.buyer.description: Builds and publishes RFQs, records outside quotes and selects winners.
pl.tenants.role.qualityEngineer.descript: Reviews supplier evidence and records deviations.
pl.tenants.role.approver.description: Approves, rejects or voids awards, never their own.
pl.tenants.role.auditor.description: Reads and exports the audit record.
pl.tenants.members.title: Members
pl.tenants.members.description: People who can sign in to {tenant}. Roles decide what each of them can do; changing a role asks you to confirm your identity again.
pl.tenants.members.column.name: Name
pl.tenants.members.empty.title: You are the only member so far
pl.tenants.members.empty.description: Invite your colleagues. They get an account in your organization only, and no role until you give them one.
pl.tenants.members.inviteDialog.title: Invite a member
pl.tenants.members.inviteDialog.descript: They receive an account in your organization with no role. Give them roles once they appear in the list.
pl.tenants.members.inviteDialog.emailInv: Enter an email address, such as name@example.com.
pl.tenants.members.rolesDialog.title: Roles for {name}
pl.tenants.members.rolesDialog.descripti: Roles add up: each one grants its own actions. A change applies from the member's next request.
pl.tenants.members.rolesDialog.unchanged: Choose at least one change before saving.
pl.tenants.members.removeDialog.title: Remove {name}?
pl.tenants.members.removeDialog.descript: They lose every role, leave your organization and are signed out at once. Their past actions stay in the audit record.
